profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: An alumnus of Western Carolina University. I earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and a Bachelor of Mathematics with a concentration in Data Science. I currently work as a software engineer, as it incorporates my passion for coding as well as problem-solving.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Apart of the Azure Cost Management team under the Cloud + AI Platform

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
• Maintained supply closet inventory for over 20 professors
• Helped organize and maintain office common areas
• Aided with client reception as needed

positions.title: Teacher Assistant and Tutor
positions.description:
•	Attended weekly computer science labs to aid students in completing their assignments
•	Hosted tutoring appointments for students that requested help in courses related to math or programming
•	Participated in meetings that discussed ways to improve the tutoring center

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Apart of the Azure Cost Management team under the Cloud + AI Platform
• Utilized Azure resources to work on a project that would greatly improve my team’s productivity by increasing performance among their systems
• Obtained valuable insight on the full software engineering process, acquiring skills that will be essential as a full-time employee
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · Azure DevOps

positions.title: Ignite Fellow
positions.description:
•	Participates in weekly workshops designed to prepare students for interviews
•	Networks with employees from Golden Door Partner companies
•	Trains to improve their likelihood of landing an internship or job opportunity in the future

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description:
• Works closely within a group of Explore interns that have end-to-end ownership for design, development, and quality of a project that will impact our broader team
• Gains hands-on experience with various tools and programming languages used in the software development field
• Collaborates with manager and mentors to evaluate requirements, estimate costs, create and implement features and services

positions.title: Tech Fellow
positions.description:
•	Received training in both technical and soft skills for 8 weeks
•	Created several projects that involved excel, coding, or web development
•	Improved professional development skills through weekly presentations and discussions
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Jupyter · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Flooring Specialist
positions.description:
•	Successfully cooperated with a team of 3 members to complete 40+ jobs
•	Implemented all project plans in a timely fashion
•	Ensured customer satisfaction subsequent to every job fulfillment

honors.title: Distinguished Academic Scholarship
